params.caption: 🖥️ Jensen Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO Nvidia's board says Jensen Huang has resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately, after weeks of affair allegations. CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent replacement. It ends a 33-year run at the top of the GPU giant. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 16:58 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 😮 React if you didn't see this coming · 💬 What does this mean for GeForce? #Nvidia #PCHardware #GamingNews
